## Figma Design (Dark Mode): Simple by Design

**Figma frame:** _Simple by Design_
**Figma file:** https://www.figma.com/design/BSr242a615D8Lbg6WjT7l1/Use-stellar-design

> **Design-only issue** — work in Figma, not in code.
> **Depends on:** UI-17 (tokens and theme), UI-19 (cards, badges, and tags), UI-20 (responsive layout grid).

### Context

Section emphasizing ease-of-use and clean abstractions with supportive UI blocks and concise copy.

### What to design (in Figma)

- Section messaging that communicates simple, clean abstractions.
- Supporting UI blocks, code-like elements, or diagrams that reinforce the narrative.
- Responsive ordering that keeps the key message and proof points together.

### Deliverables

- Desktop and mobile Simple by Design frames.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Concise copy and supportive UI blocks reinforce the simplicity message
- [ ] Supporting UI is legible and not decorative noise
- [ ] Uses UI-17 tokens, UI-19 components where applicable, and UI-20 grid rules
- [ ] Dark-mode contrast is sufficient for copy and interface elements
- [ ] Figma frame link is shared for review

### Important rules

- Get assigned before beginning work.
- Work only in the assigned Figma frame.
- Use the shared design system and reusable components; do not use loose styles.
- Dark mode only.
